compile_state: not compiled locally: rustc/rustfmt were not available in the local executable path; root must format and compile the exact delta before physical execution

field_semantics.bytes: logical retained KV2 payload bytes for Service spans; declared ciphertext bytes for quorum/install spans; zero where not yet selected
field_semantics.completed: the observed nested phase returned without its own error; never a mutation or HTTP pass claim
field_semantics.generation: current selected local source generation, or prior Raft generation for publication; zero at source-enrollment phase means not yet selected
field_semantics.objects: candidate staged objects for Service spans; whole declared ciphertext closure objects for quorum/install spans
field_semantics.original_deadline_expired: observation at phase end, before diagnostic output; not a new deadline or final success guarantee

logging: one public line on a phase finish or error unwind; stderr failure is ignored
nested_spans: service_ha_publication includes publication subphases; service_local_install includes install subphases; do not sum parent plus children
